events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for a regional war. This could lead to increased volatility in the oil market and beyond. The situation is being closely monitored by global leaders.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to a spike in oil prices, which would have a ripple effect on the global economy. This could lead to increased volatility in the stock market, making it a good time to buy into the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY). On the other hand, the increased uncertainty could lead to a flight to safety, making it a good time to short the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT).

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and be prepared to adjust your position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the conflict is resolved or if the oil price stabilizes
